content.value: The following consecutive readings were taken with a level and a 4-meter (20) leveling staff on a continuously sloping ground at common intervals of 25 m: 2.775 m (on A), 1.501 m, 1.322 m, 2.127 m, 2.811 m, 3.055 m, 3.366 m, 2.055 m, 2.433 m, 0.519 m, 1.589 m, 2.700 m, 3.500 m and 3.363 m (on B). The RL of A was 445.500 m. Make entries in a level book and apply the usual checks. The change points were taken at 75 m and 200 m in chainage.
